title: •Slip Sliding Away
caption: •Slip Sliding Away (V)
game_text: Cancel Path Of Least Resistance. {sense} OR During your move phase, target opponent’s character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target’s ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane.
